findings.title: Projeção restrita de benfeitores não possui teste de regressão
findings.body: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:131-153 introduz a allowlist que protege CPF, endereço, CEP e metadados de recibo da Secretaria, mas __tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:220-228 só inspeciona a projeção restrita de solicitações. → Path: substituir esta consulta de Secretaria por findMany sem columns, ou adicionar cpf/endereço/recibo à allowlist, continua aprovando toda a suíte. → Verdict: uma regressão que reexpõe dados sensíveis de benfeitores ao papel Secretaria não tem teste capaz de falhar. Adicione caso com identidade Secretaria que inspecione a projeção de donorPledges e confirme os campos proibidos ausentes.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:131-153 limita colunas de benfeitores para Secretaria → Path: nenhum teste chama getDonorPledges como Secretaria → Verdict: reintroduzir campos sensíveis mantém a suíte verde.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:127-153 → o desvio por papel e a allowlist de donorPledges são novos e são a fronteira de minimização de dados.
__tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:220-228 → a única asserção de columns para Secretaria cobre applications/students, não donorPledges.
rg em __tests__ por getDonorPledges/SecretariatDonorsClient → não há teste que invoque a consulta de benfeitores com papel Secretaria.
findings.suggestion: Cubra getDonorPledges como Secretaria, verificando a allowlist completa e a ausência explícita de cpf, endereço, cep e recibo_path.

findings.title: Emissão imutável não é protegida pelos testes de exportação
findings.body: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:552 persiste a versão final depois de renderizar a decisão (e app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:807 faz o mesmo para contrato), mas __tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:570 e :706 só verificam o PDF retornado. → Path: remover ou quebrar qualquer chamada a persistIssuedDocument nos dois exports ainda deixa os testes atuais verdes. → Verdict: uma regressão elimina o histórico imutável exigido sem teste capaz de falhar. Faça os testes de decisão e contrato verificarem a escrita de issued_documents, incluindo application_id, kind, emissor e a falha de persistência.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:552 e :807 persistem o artefato final → Path: os testes de exportação só observam PDF/filename → Verdict: remover a persistência mantém a suíte verde e perde o histórico imutável.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:549-554 → o retorno de exportDecision depende de persistIssuedDocument, que é a única gravação do artefato imutável.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:804-809 → exportContract repete a mesma dependência de persistência.
__tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:570-614 e :706-733 → os casos de sucesso verificam apenas base64/filename/conteúdo renderizado, sem assertir a gravação nem sua falha.
findings.suggestion: Adicione asserções de inserted para cada export e um caso que simule a falha de persistência e exija o erro de emissão.

findings.title: Fluxo operacional exclusivo da Secretaria não tem cobertura de UI
findings.body: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:83-141 e app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:93-102 adicionam as interfaces pelas quais a Secretaria lê o acompanhamento, emite observações e baixa documentos finais, mas os testes de clientes importam somente SolicitacoesClient administrativo. → Path: quebrar o carregamento ao abrir o cartão, a submissão de observação ou a listagem/busca da interface de Secretaria não falha em teste algum. → Verdict: os fluxos públicos de trabalho introduzidos para o novo papel podem regressar silenciosamente apesar da suíte verde. Teste a abertura do cartão, carregamento de observações/documentos, registro de nota e a busca de benfeitores da Secretaria.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:103-127 implementa o acompanhamento da Secretaria → Path: os testes montam somente o cliente administrativo → Verdict: falhas de abertura, nota ou documentos da Secretaria mantêm a suíte verde.
app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:103-127 → os efeitos de abertura chamam ações de observações/documentos e a ação de gravação.
app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:93-102 → a lista de benfeitores exclusiva da Secretaria implementa a busca operacional.
__tests__/solicitacoes-client.test.tsx:61 e imports → a suíte monta SolicitacoesClient, não SecretariatApplicationsClient; rg em __tests__ não encontra SecretariatDonorsClient.
findings.suggestion: Inclua testes de renderização e interação para ambos os clientes de Secretaria, com ações assíncronas controladas.

findings.title: Populated-database migration behavior lacks deploy-gate coverage
findings.body: Premise: `0006` changes populated `admin_users` rows by adding nullable `role`, backfilling it, and then enforcing the role constraint and non-null state at lines 26–31, but the automated suite does not invoke the migration from the preceding schema. → Path: a future change to the DDL order, legacy backfill, or constraints can leave fake-DB action tests green while failing on the deployed database containing existing users and `applications.decided_by` references. → Verdict: the required additive rollout behavior can regress without detection before deployment.
evidence: Premise: populated admin_users is mutated in ordered DDL → Path: no test applies 0006 from snapshot 0005 with a legacy account and decision reference → Verdict: rollout compatibility is unguarded.
drizzle/0006_flimsy_spacker_dave.sql:26-31 → role is added nullable, backfilled to admin, constrained, made non-null, then given a default.

.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_01.md:105-111 → requires integration coverage that applies the migration to legacy staff and decisions, validates constraints and foreign keys, and proves additive migration behavior.
rg -n -i 'migration|migrate|0006|legacy|backfill|populated' __tests__ → no automated test invokes the Drizzle migration or establishes the required pre-0006 database state.

findings.title: Lock de versão concorrente não é exercitado pela suíte
findings.body: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:23 usa SELECT ... FOR UPDATE para serializar a alocação de versão, mas __tests__/issued-documents.test.ts:16-22 apenas simula a leitura da última versão e a inserção. → Path: remover o lock, movê-lo para depois da consulta, ou emitir duas solicitações concorrentes com a mesma versão ainda deixa a suíte atual verde. → Verdict: a garantia que evita colisão de versão/reemissão concorrente não tem proteção capaz de detectar regressão. Faça o duplo registrar tx.execute e teste que o lock ocorre antes de findFirst; idealmente cubra duas emissões concorrentes em PostgreSQL ou um teste de integração equivalente.
evidence: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:23 serializa versões com FOR UPDATE → Path: o teste não observa execute nem a ordem com findFirst → Verdict: remover ou reordenar o lock mantém a suíte verde e permite regressão concorrente.
lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:21-29 → a segurança da versão depende da ordem lock → leitura da última versão → insert.
__tests__/helpers/fake-db.ts:100-102 → transaction cria execute como mock, portanto é observável.
__tests__/issued-documents.test.ts:16-22 → nenhum assert observa tx.execute ou a ordem relativa ao findFirst.
findings.suggestion: Exponha/registre o execute transacional no fake DB e assegure que o lock ocorre antes da consulta da versão; complemente com uma prova de concorrência real quando a infraestrutura de integração estiver disponível.

advisories.title: Keep task tracking status aligned with the delivered work
advisories.body: The task list leaves tasks 02 through 05 as `pending`, although their corresponding implementation files and tests are present in this same change set. Updating the tracker when each acceptance checklist is verified makes the Compozy artifact usable as an accurate handoff and avoids asking a later executor to repeat completed work.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_tasks.md:8-11 marks all remaining scoped tasks pending → Improvement: the workflow artifact can reliably show what remains after verification → Fix: set each completed task to completed and retain pending only for unverified acceptance work.
git status --short → shows scoped implementation and test files for staff profiles, issued documents, public routes, and required uploads alongside this task list.

advisories.title: Align the documented application action surface with exported actions
advisories.body: The Server Action table presents `getCurrentStaff` and `getOperationalApplicationDetail`, neither of which is exported, while the actual role-specific projection is performed by `getApplications`. The same table calls the existing `exportApplication` action Administrator-only but does not identify the current export names in the final-document section. Keeping the contract names synchronized avoids implementers and future tests targeting a nonexistent action boundary.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:322 and :342 name `getCurrentStaff` and `getOperationalApplicationDetail` → Improvement: the design document becomes an accurate action contract for maintenance and test planning → Fix: remove or rename the nonexistent rows and describe the existing role dispatch in `getApplications`; use the actual final-document export action names.

rg -n '^export (async )?function ' app/admin/_actions/{admin-actions,staff-actions,observation-actions}.ts → lists `getApplications`, `exportDecision`, and `exportContract`, but no `getCurrentStaff`, `getOperationalApplicationDetail`, `issueDecision`, or `issueContract`.

advisories.title: Update completed task tracking
advisories.body: Tasks 02 through 05 still declare `status: pending` and retain unchecked subtasks even though their matching implementation and focused tests are included in this change. Updating each verified task record makes the Compozy handoff accurately identify completed scope rather than suggesting the next executor must repeat it.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_02.md:2 and :41-47 retain pending status and unchecked subtasks while the matching staff, observation, role-projection, and test files are present in this change → Improvement: the workflow handoff identifies completed scope accurately → Fix: mark verified tasks and subtasks complete after the final acceptance evidence is recorded.
git status --short → shows the scoped implementation and focused tests for staff profiles, issued documents, canonical public routes, and required uploads beside the task files.

advisories.title: Name the administrative authorization guard for its actual policy
advisories.body: `requireAuth` now exclusively calls `requireAdmin`, but its generic name still implies that any authenticated staff member can use the action. Renaming the local helper to `requireAdminAction` (or calling `requireAdmin` directly) makes the administrator-only boundary obvious at each protected action and reduces the chance that a future action accidentally inherits the stricter policy.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:43-45 defines `requireAuth` as a wrapper around `requireAdmin` → Improvement: callers communicate the role boundary without having to inspect the helper → Fix: rename it to an administrator-specific name and update its callers, or use `requireAdmin` directly.
rg -n "requireAuth\(" app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts → finds the generic name at the protected application, donor, settings, and document actions.

advisories.title: Decompose the secretariat card into named UI sections
advisories.body: The new card combines data loading, note mutation, download handling, status presentation, document links, and the complete observations form in one component. Extracting named sections and small view-model helpers would make its role-specific data boundary and later UI changes easier to review without changing behavior.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:100-139 keeps the role-specific state, actions, and all rendered sections in SecretariatApplicationCard → Improvement: named sections isolate each operational concern and reduce the review surface for future sensitive-data changes → Fix: extract the status, issued-documents, and observations sections plus their small handlers into named components/helpers.
app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:105-123 → one component owns both observation and issued-document server-action flows.
app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:125-136 → the entire role-specific presentation is embedded in the same component.

advisories.title: Give the staff-management flows readable function bodies
advisories.body: Creation, activation, reset, and rendering are each compressed into single physical lines. Expanding them into normal blocks would make the error and optimistic-update branches auditable, especially for a component that manages privileged access.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/usuarios/client.tsx:8-16 defines three asynchronous account-management flows and the complete JSX tree as one-line expressions → Improvement: branch behavior can be inspected and changed without re-parsing dense expressions → Fix: format the handlers and JSX into conventional blocks, retaining the same calls and state transitions.
app/admin/usuarios/client.tsx:13-15 → all server-action success and failure branches are densely inlined.
app/admin/usuarios/client.tsx:16 → the account-management UI is one nested JSX expression.

advisories.title: Remove vestigial unconditional validation blocks
advisories.body: After removing the feature flag, four standalone brace blocks remain around required-document validation. They do not create a meaningful scope and look like a condition was accidentally removed, which obscures that these checks are now unconditional.
evidence: Premise: app/form/_components/scholarship-form.tsx:52-63 wraps unconditional document checks in a bare block → Improvement: direct control flow makes the mandatory-upload invariant immediately apparent → Fix: remove the bare braces in all four validators without changing the contained checks.
app/form/_components/scholarship-form.tsx:102-107,127-130,138-141 → the same vestigial block pattern recurs in the remaining document validators.

advisories.title: Centralize the duplicated scholarship layout
advisories.body: The canonical layout duplicates app/form/layout.tsx exactly. Maintaining both copies lets institutional copy, accessibility semantics, and responsive classes drift even though the legacy route only redirects to the canonical flow.
evidence: Premise: app/solicitar-bolsa/layout.tsx:11-104 has the same layout implementation as app/form/layout.tsx:1-104 → Improvement: one authoritative layout prevents future visual and semantic drift across the two route trees → Fix: extract the shared layout body to a component and make both route layouts delegate to it.
cmp app/form/layout.tsx app/solicitar-bolsa/layout.tsx → exited 0, confirming the files are currently byte-for-byte identical.

advisories.title: Evite converter a transação para o tipo global de banco
advisories.body: A conversão `tx as unknown as typeof db` descarta a verificação de tipos exatamente no bloco que precisa permanecer atômico. Consultar a versão com o query builder da própria transação (por exemplo, `tx.select({ version: issuedDocuments.version })...`) preserva os tipos e torna futuras mudanças na transação verificáveis pelo compilador.
evidence: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:20 converte `tx` por `unknown` para `typeof db` → Improvement: o compilador volta a validar a API usada dentro da unidade atômica → Fix: substitua a leitura relacional por uma consulta tipada em `tx`.
lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:19-39 → a única finalidade do cast é chamar `query.issuedDocuments.findFirst` antes do insert da transação.

suppressions.candidate: Cast transaction as root Drizzle client
suppressions.note: Inspected the transaction calls and the database contract; no concrete runtime failure was established from the type-only cast.

suppressions.candidate: Best-effort path update after storage move
suppressions.note: The adjacent implementation and URL resolver preserve access through the deterministic application path when the row retains pending/.

suppressions.candidate: Administrator access to issued document history
suppressions.note: The role design explicitly permits administrators to inspect version history; secretariat is restricted to the current eligible document.

suppressions.candidate: Compressed JSX formatting
suppressions.note: The formatting is formatter-owned and does not establish a functional issue.

suppressions.candidate: Phased rollout can be read as separate releases despite the coordinated-release goal.
suppressions.note: The headings describe implementation phases and each has exit criteria; the PRD explicitly requires one coordinated release at line 25, so no concrete documentation ambiguity requires a change.

suppressions.candidate: ADR date may become stale over time.
suppressions.note: The date is a normal ADR decision date and no evidence indicates it is incorrect.

suppressions.candidate: External reference URLs may change.
suppressions.note: No inspected evidence shows the linked sources are unavailable or unsuitable.

suppressions.candidate: Long mock setup declarations and assertions need formatting edits.
suppressions.note: The inspected test setup is functionally clear; line wrapping is formatter-owned and has no separate maintainability fix.

suppressions.candidate: The ADR's storage-growth consequence needs a retention policy.
suppressions.note: Immutable issued-version retention is an explicit product decision, and no concrete operational requirement establishes a missing policy.

suppressions.candidate: Compressed JSX and hook bodies reduce local readability.
suppressions.note: This is formatter-owned presentation rather than a distinct structural change; the implementation has no repeated logic beyond normal list rendering.

suppressions.candidate: Double type assertions hide the role-specific result shape.
suppressions.note: The role branch follows the server action projection and TypeScript checks the build; no inspected caller demonstrates a mismatched payload.

suppressions.candidate: Upload category allowlist rejects a legitimate form field
suppressions.note: The reviewed form fields use only the fixed categories or indexed student categories accepted by isAllowedUploadCategory.

suppressions.candidate: Mandatory upload size check can reject normal documents
suppressions.note: The branch is intentionally limited to missing or empty storage objects; no concrete normal-upload failure path was found.

suppressions.candidate: Student removal guard leaves stale indexed uploads
suppressions.note: The guard explicitly prevents index shifts when a later student has uploads, preserving the signed category invariant.

suppressions.candidate: Legacy form route no longer reads the active school year
suppressions.note: The permanent redirect deliberately hands canonical rendering and its dynamic data read to /solicitar-bolsa.

suppressions.candidate: Expand the compressed JSX tree into multiple lines
suppressions.note: The component is emitted as one long JSX line, but the requested change is presentation-only and has no independent maintainability boundary beyond formatter-owned wrapping.

suppressions.candidate: Remove the trailing blank line and normalize the request prose
suppressions.note: This user-owned change-request document was already modified outside the implementation; its prose and EOF whitespace are not product-source debt introduced by the reviewed feature.

suppressions.candidate: Replace the local SVG img with next/image
suppressions.note: The asset is a local SVG with explicit dimensions, so no concrete optimization or maintenance benefit was established for a different image component.

suppressions.candidate: Manually simplify or reformat the Drizzle schema snapshot
suppressions.note: The assigned JSON is a generated Drizzle migration snapshot; jq parses it successfully and its new role, observation, and issued-document metadata mirrors migration 0006. Regenerating it, rather than hand-editing it for style, preserves migration-tool ownership.

suppressions.candidate: Alterar manualmente a representação extensa do snapshot Drizzle
suppressions.note: O snapshot é artefato gerado da migração; não há melhoria manual específica e segura a propor.

suppressions.candidate: Adicionar quebra de linha ao fim do journal
suppressions.note: A possível alteração é de formatação de arquivo gerado e não entrega benefício de manutenção local.

suppressions.candidate: Trocar o Set de capacidades por objeto ou enum
suppressions.note: O conjunto é curto, imutável por encapsulamento e a troca não apresenta benefício concreto sobre o uso atual.

suppressions.candidate: Exigir imutabilidade de observações exclusivamente por restrição SQL
suppressions.note: A mudança adiciona a tabela; a inexistência de permissões SQL específicas não prova um caminho concreto de mutação dentro desta aplicação.

suppressions.candidate: Restringir ainda mais o formato dos caminhos pendentes no schema
suppressions.note: A validação de categoria e namespace é realizada pelo fluxo de submissão; qualquer avaliação de segurança dessa fronteira pertence à varredura de segurança.

suppressions.candidate: Alterar a marcação interna do SVG para acessibilidade
suppressions.note: A acessibilidade é determinada pelo componente consumidor da imagem; o asset isolado não permite afirmar uma melhoria local.

suppressions.candidate: Remover os valores explícitos de papel e atividade no bootstrap
suppressions.note: Os valores explícitos documentam a identidade inicial e alinham o bootstrap à nova política de papéis.

suppressions.candidate: A stale staff cookie could retain capabilities after role change or deactivation.
suppressions.note: requireStaff treats the session as an identity hint only, then reads admin_users for role and ativo on each protected action or page; missing and inactive users are rejected before capability dispatch.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat application responses could include financial or applicant-evidence data.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria branch uses explicit applications and students column allowlists at the database boundary, before the client component receives any rows.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat donor responses could include CPF, address, CEP, or receipt metadata.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria donor query selects only the operational allowlist and omits CPF, address, CEP, and receipt fields before serialization.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat user could mint a ticket for applicant evidence by supplying a storage path.
suppressions.note: getDocumentUrl calls requireAuth, whose only implementation requires Administrator. The distinct final-document action resolves a persisted document ID server-side.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat user could download a historical final version or an ineligible contract by guessing its ID.
suppressions.note: The action resolves the ID server-side and, for Secretaria, compares it with the role-aware current-document list. That list excludes pending applications and contracts for rejected applications, while current selection keeps only the latest version per kind.

suppressions.candidate: An observation could execute markup entered by Secretariat.
suppressions.note: The reviewed observation renderers put body content in React text nodes and contain no dangerouslySetInnerHTML path, so supplied markup is escaped.

suppressions.candidate: An anonymous caller could mint a ticket for traversal, arbitrary namespace, or uncontrolled category.
suppressions.note: Category values are an allowlist plus strictly indexed student categories, filenames are sanitized with dot segments rejected, and every signed target is generated under a fresh pending UUID.

suppressions.candidate: The current-document API could expose server-only storage paths to Secretariat.
suppressions.note: Current and history listings use explicit selections that omit storage_path. The only path-bearing lookup remains internal to the ticket-issuing server action.

suppressions.candidate: Download ticket redemption is not bound to an active session.
suppressions.note: The retained design authorizes before issuing a ticket. Delivery verifies a download-scoped HMAC signature and five-minute expiry, matching the stated ticket-only endpoint contract.

suppressions.candidate: Role constraints could reject existing accounts during rollout
suppressions.note: The SQL adds role as nullable, backfills all null values to admin, then adds the check and non-null requirement; this is the required compatibility sequence.

suppressions.candidate: New observation and issued-document foreign keys could invalidate legacy rows
suppressions.note: Both new tables begin empty, reference existing primary keys, and encode the specified application cascade and author/issuer restrict actions.

suppressions.candidate: Allowlist de categorias e normalização de upload não têm teste de ramificação.
suppressions.note: __tests__/form-actions.test.ts:104-117 cobre cada categoria suportada e amostras inválidas, enquanto __tests__/submit-application.test.ts:232-241 testa categoria obrigatória trocada, caminho reutilizado e índice de aluno incorreto.

suppressions.candidate: Papel/atividade atuais da sessão podem deixar de ser revalidados.
suppressions.note: __tests__/authorization.test.ts:26-83 cobre identidade ausente, conta removida/inativa, capacidades de Secretaria, administrador e bypass fora de produção.

suppressions.candidate: Administração de contas Secretaria não possui proteção contra alteração de administrador.
suppressions.note: __tests__/staff-and-observations.test.ts:28-34 verifica explicitamente que troca de atividade e redefinição de senha não alteram administrador.

suppressions.candidate: Current-document projection shares metadata with Administrator history
suppressions.note: The shared projection deliberately omits storage_path and is the TechSpec's IssuedDocumentSummary contract, which includes issuer metadata; the separate Administrator-only history action controls access to prior versions.

suppressions.candidate: Role-hidden configuration navigation could remain reachable by direct URL
suppressions.note: Every unavailable configuration page and /admin/usuarios invokes requireAdmin at the page boundary, while its backing action independently invokes requireAdmin; the sidebar is not the authorization boundary.

suppressions.candidate: Ticket categories and submitted document categories use different labels
suppressions.note: The path category is validated before persistence and the normalized database categories intentionally group per-student documents while retaining student_id; marriage's path category certidao is validated before its persisted certidao_casamento label is assigned.

suppressions.candidate: Staff authorization could trust a stale role or active state from the session
suppressions.note: TechSpec §Staff Identity and Authorization requires database revalidation. requireStaff resolves the session only as an identity hint and selects role and ativo from admin_users on every protected operation; the development bypass is explicitly limited outside production.

suppressions.candidate: The Secretariat application view could return a restricted financial or evidence field
suppressions.note: PRD §Secretariat Operational Application View and TechSpec §Applications are met by the Secretaria branch's database-side allowlist for application identity/contact fields and student id/name only; the full-detail action remains Administrator-only.

suppressions.candidate: The Secretariat benefactor view could include scholarship-suggested people or restricted donor fields
suppressions.note: PRD §Secretariat Benefactor View and TechSpec §Benefactors require public-form donor_pledges only. The operational query reads donorPledges with an explicit allowlist and excludes CPF, address, CEP, receipt fields, export, and deletion; scholarship benefactors are a separate relation and are not queried.

suppressions.candidate: Concurrent final-document reissues could allocate duplicate versions
suppressions.note: Task 03 requirement 4 and TechSpec §Final Documents are satisfied: persistence locks the application row before finding the latest per-kind version, while the migration adds a unique application_id/kind/version index.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat could obtain an unissued, historic, rejected-contract, or path-addressed final document
suppressions.note: Task 03 requirements 6–8 and TechSpec §Final Documents are met: reads accept persisted IDs, ticket creation resolves storage_path server-side, Secretariat compares the ID to current outcome-eligible versions, and history is requireAdmin-only.

suppressions.candidate: A direct scholarship submission or upload-ticket call could bypass the enabled document contract
suppressions.note: Task 05 requirements 5–12 and TechSpec §Scholarship Upload Removal are met: the schema requires every document field, validateDocumentCategories requires each fixed and indexed student category below a pending UUID path, and createUploadUrl uses a fixed/strict-index category allowlist with sanitized filenames.

suppressions.candidate: Public hierarchy, canonical links, or legacy-route continuity could contradict the donor-first contract
suppressions.note: PRD §Donor-First Public Hierarchy and Task 04 requirements 1–10 are met by document-order navigation, hero, benefactor band, and quick access using canonical benefactor-before-scholarship links; the old route pages are direct permanent redirects and the canonical scholarship route declares force-dynamic.

suppressions.candidate: The shared public seal could differ from the approved master or lack its required semantic modes
suppressions.note: Task 04 requirements 12–15 are met: public/seal-arca.svg byte-matches docs/design/opendesign/assets/seal-arca-master.svg, and SealLogo forwards caller sizing/classes while distinguishing decorative and informative alternatives.
